extract_loading_pipeline: extract only image and annotation loading steps from an mmdet data pipeline config list
filter_pipeline_configs: filter a list of pipeline config dicts to keep only LoadImageFromFile and LoadAnnotations entries
validate_loading_pipeline: validate that a data pipeline config contains exactly two loading steps for images and annotations
review_get_loading_pipeline: review the get_loading_pipeline function that filters mmdet pipeline configs to loading-only steps
summarize_get_loading_pipeline: summarize the get_loading_pipeline function which extracts loading transforms from an mmdet pipeline
